comparison.objective: Connect three solar panels in series with correct lead polarity; candidate breaks and recovers insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve small-part insertion, but flexible-lead placement into couplers and polarity sequencing do not test tool-mediated impact, notch fracture, or fragment containment.
comparison.success_condition: Specified red/black leads touch coupler stops and outer leads remain free versus four fractured tangs recovered with inserts fixed and undamaged.
comparison.reason: Electrical connector insertion and polarity correctness are meaningfully different from controlled tang break-off.
